dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Ah, it's basically an eating contest — everyone eats as much as they can, and the one who eats the most wins!

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: It brings more people through the door and presents a great opportunity to introduce new dishes while they're here...

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: But all that's just a bonus. The most important thing is that everyone can eat and be happy! That's the dream of every chef!
